verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Realtime is a WebRTC SFU/TURN platform, so per-session quality metrics are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents packet loss, jitter, bitrate, or any call-quality analytics in a dashboard or API. Signed meeting and participant events (docs-38) are a different capability and do not count as quality metrics.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, and bitrate are available through a dashboard or API for debugging calls
